configuration.title: Job Offer Negotiation
configuration.description: A candidate negotiates salary and work arrangements with a hiring manager.

agents.name: Job Candidate
agents.role_description: Negotiates compensation and work arrangements before accepting a job offer.
agents.goal: Secure a salary of at least 12 LPA and two remote workdays per week.
constraints: Prefers at least two remote workdays per week.

agents.name: Hiring Manager
agents.role_description: Hires a qualified developer while staying within the company's compensation and work policy limits.
agents.goal: Hire the candidate at a salary no higher than 15 LPA with at most three remote workdays per week.
constraints: Allows no more than three remote workdays per week.

history.reasoning: Job Candidate opens with salary 15.0, remote_days 3. As a Collaborative negotiator it moves towards a fair middle ground.
Hiring Manager accepts the offer (salary 15.0, remote_days 3) because it is within its limits and meets its current goal.
